WITH award_players AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pa.player_id
  FROM player_award pa
  INNER JOIN player p ON pa.player_id = p.player_id
),
hand_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.bats, '') AS bats,
    COUNT(*) AS player_count
  FROM award_players ap
  INNER JOIN player p ON ap.player_id = p.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.bats, '')
),
hand_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    bats,
    player_count,
    CAST(player_count AS NUMERIC) / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM hand_counts
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM hand_stats
)
SELECT 
  bats AS batting_hand,
  player_count,
  share,
  share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share) AS above_average
FROM hand_stats
WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)
ORDER BY bats;

assumptions.assumption: NULL batting hand values are converted to empty string ('') to represent missing hands as their own group in the output. The request specifies that blank/missing hands should be their own group but is ambiguous about display representation.

alternatives.interpretation: Preserve NULL values as NULL in the output rather than converting to empty string
